title: Sayyidul Istighfar - The Best Forgiveness
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ
latin: Allahumma Anta Rabbi la ilaha illa Anta, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka...
translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant...
lesson: Whoever says this with certainty in the day and dies before evening will be among people of Jannah. Powerful.
